videos.title: How a Jet Engine Actually Works (3D) ✈️🔥
videos.description:
Suck, squeeze, bang, blow: we cut a jet engine open in mid-air to see the fan, compressor, combustor and turbines at work.
What should I cut open next, a rocket or a helicopter? 👇
